7.3.1.1.1 Provision of MetaInfo
[SWS_DM_02094] Provision of source address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the source address (SA) of the diagnostic client from which the
diagnostic request was received within metaInfo using the Key kSA in all the subse-
quently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02095] Provision of target address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the target address (TA) of the diagnostic server to which the
diagnostic request was sent within metaInfo using the Key kTA in all the subsequently
called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02096] Provision of UDS addressing mode
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the UDS addressing mode (TAType) of the diagnostic request
(physical or functional) within metaInfo using the Key kTAType in all the subsequently
called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
